mapper.sql: m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name, m.owner_user_id, u.nick_name owner_name, m.contact_phone, m.logo, m.address, m.open_time, m.close_time, m.notice, m.status, m.del_flag, m.version, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark
mapper.select: select from takeout_merchant m left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.owner_user_id where m.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and m.del_flag = '0'
select from takeout_merchant m left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.owner_user_id where m.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and m.del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into takeout_merchant (merchant_name, owner_user_id, contact_phone, logo, address, open_time, close_time, notice, status, del_flag, version, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{merchantName}, #{ownerUserId}, #{contactPhone}, #{logo}, #{address}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime}, #{notice}, #{status}, '0', 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update takeout_merchant set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and del_flag = '0'
